chat.privacyTitle: Before you use the AI service
chat.privacyBody: If you continue, your question, chosen language and province, and your last few messages will be sent to an external AI service that this website's operator has configured. Do not include names, phone numbers, CNIC numbers, addresses or other personal details. Conversations are kept only in this browser tab and are not saved by this website.
chat.limitations: This assistant provides general legal information, not legal advice. It may be incomplete or out of date and cannot guarantee any outcome. For your situation, consult a qualified lawyer.
chat.foundDocs: I found these documents in the legal library that may help:

chat.needJurisdiction: Tip: the answer to this question can differ by province. Select your province in the header so I can prioritise the right law.
chat.insufficient: The available sources are not sufficient to answer this reliably. Please consult an authoritative source or a qualified lawyer.
chat.sessionNote: Messages stay in this browser tab only.
chat.footerNote: Legal information only — not legal advice.

footer.disclaimer: Pakistan Legal Guide provides general legal information, not legal advice. It does not create a lawyer–client relationship and cannot guarantee any legal outcome. Laws change and differ between provinces — always check the official source and consult a qualified lawyer for your situation.
footer.copyright: Built as an open, static website. Legal texts belong to their official publishers.

about.title: About, Sources & Privacy
about.mission: Pakistan Legal Guide is a free, static website that helps ordinary people find and understand Pakistani laws. It runs entirely in your browser: there are no accounts, no tracking and no server that stores your searches.
about.verifyBody: Every legal document shows a verification badge. “Verified” means checked against the official source on the stated date. “Source linked” means the official portal is linked but the details have not yet been verified line by line. “Illustrative” means demonstration content that is not a verified legal document. Original statutory wording is never edited, and explanations and translations are labelled as written for this site.
about.translationBody: Sindhi and Urdu interface text, glossary equivalents and explanations are working translations that have not been professionally reviewed. We never present a translation as an official translation of a statute. Where a translation does not exist, you will see a clear label and the English text.
about.privacyBody: We do not collect personal information. Your language and province choices are stored only in your browser (local storage). Searches run locally. If an operator has configured an external AI service, your question is sent to it only after you accept a privacy notice. Chat history is kept in memory for the current tab and is not saved.
about.limitsBody: The library is a small, growing collection of representative entries. It is not a complete record of Pakistani law. Laws are amended often; confirm the current text on the official portal.
about.ragBody: Search on this website is a simple local keyword index. It is not semantic search and not retrieval-augmented generation (RAG). Generative answers are only available when the operator connects a separate, secure backend.
